metadata.source: United Nations Statistics Division (UN Comtrade v1) / UN Trade & Development (UNCTAD)
metadata.methodology: Bilateral Mirror Trade & Asymmetry Analysis (IMTS 2010 Concepts and Definitions)
metadata.statutory_basis: WTO Trade Policy Review Mechanism (TPRM) & WCO Customs Valuation Agreement (Article VII GATT 1994)

LOW.label: Low / Typical Transport & Insurance Variance
LOW.implication: Reported values align within normal maritime freight and insurance margins. Low illicit trade risk.

MODERATE.label: Moderate Discrepancy / Transit Gap
MODERATE.implication: Variance exceeds standard CIF/FOB markups. Attributable to transshipment delays, exchange rate lag, or tariff classification mismatch.

CRITICAL.label: Critical Misinvoicing / Tariff Evasion Alert
CRITICAL.implication: Severe statistical asymmetry. High probability of trade-based money laundering (TBML), duty evasion, or capital flight.

300490.description: Medicaments consisting of mixed or unmixed products for therapeutic uses (Generic Pharma)
300490.common_causes: Air freight temperature-controlled pharma chain; minimal customs valuation divergence; strict US FDA e-pedigree tracking.

710239.description: Diamonds, non-industrial, worked, cut or faceted (Surat Polished Gems)
710239.common_causes: High-value, low-volume air couriers (Brink's/Malca-Amit). Kimberley Process certification reconciliation lag.

851713.description: Smartphones and cellular network devices (PLI Manufacturing Export)
851713.common_causes: High-frequency express air shipments from Chennai / Bengaluru hubs; tightly reconciled by multinational OEM accounting.

847130.description: Laptops, tablets and portable data processing machines (China ➔ India Inflow)
847130.common_causes: Significant mirror gap (+42.7%). Transit routing through Hong Kong / Singapore hubs; valuation under-reporting to compress Indian BCD / IGST liability.

293399.description: Heterocyclic compounds with nitrogen hetero-atom(s) (Pharma Bulk Drugs / APIs)
293399.common_causes: Substantial mirror variance (+27.7%). Transfer pricing between bulk chemical syndicates; bonded warehouse re-invoicing.

260111.description: Non-agglomerated iron ores and concentrates (Odisha / Goa ➔ China)
260111.common_causes: Bulk ocean dry bulk capesize/panamax shipping freight swings; moisture content deduction adjustments between load port and discharge port.

711319.description: Articles of jewelry and parts thereof, of precious metal (Gold & Diamond Jewelry)
711319.common_causes: CEPA tariff preference arbitrage; hand-carriage passenger consignment reporting discrepancies; Dubai gold souk re-export aggregation.

271019.description: Medium oils and preparations, petroleum oils other than crude (Refined Fuels)
271019.common_causes: Offshore bunkering and tanker transshipment outside territorial waters; Fujairah floating storage discharge discrepancies.

870829.description: Parts and accessories of bodies for motor vehicles (Automotive Components)
870829.common_causes: Regular containerized maritime flow via Hamburg / Bremerhaven. Values closely track expected CIF freight and insurance markups.

620442.description: Women's or girls' dresses of cotton (Textile & Garment Apparel)
620442.common_causes: Seasonal fashion inventory air-freight vs ocean container split; EU generalized scheme of preferences (GSP) documentation reconciliation.

610910.description: T-shirts, singlets and other vests, knitted or crocheted, of cotton
610910.common_causes: Tirupur direct retail sourcing; UK Developing Countries Trading Scheme (DCTS) tariff compliance; tight container logistics.

300420.description: Medicaments containing other antibiotics, for retail sale
300420.common_causes: NHS procurement framework consignments; high regulatory auditability by MHRA (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency).

271012.description: Light oils and preparations, motor spirit (Gasoline / Clean Refined Fuels)
271012.common_causes: Rotterdam ARA (Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp) refinery hub re-exports across Northwestern Europe; substantial in-transit floating cargo re-routing.

851713.common_causes: European distribution center (EDC) transit warehousing; subsequent intra-EU dispatch via VAT reverse charge.
